researchQuestion: Do liquidity quality and covenant-trigger states identify nonlinear funding/default pressure beyond leverage, maturity and interest coverage?
mechanism: Liquidity risk is inability to meet cash obligations when due, not simply low accounting cash.
Maintenance covenants can transfer bargaining/control rights to lenders before formal default; incurrence covenants constrain actions when a transaction is attempted.
A covenant breach can lead to waiver, repricing, collateral demands, commitment reduction, acceleration or restructuring; severity depends on contract and lender condition.
Committed facilities can buffer maturity pressure only when legally/operationally drawable.

evidenceAndCounterevidence.support: Research shows covenant violations can trigger renegotiation, deleveraging and credit-commitment changes.
evidenceAndCounterevidence.counter: Violation consequences vary; waivers and lender relationships can materially soften outcomes.

evidenceAndCounterevidence.support: Liquidity and default risk interact in observed credit spreads.
evidenceAndCounterevidence.counter: High cash can be trapped/pledged/operationally required; headline liquidity is not necessarily available funding.

evidenceAndCounterevidence.support: Tighter monetary conditions can amplify covenant channels.
evidenceAndCounterevidence.counter: Credit-demand weakness can mimic supply tightening, so causality requires separate controls.

taiwanSourceRoute: Taiwan annual-report/prospectus bond tables disclose restrictive covenants/redemption terms where applicable.
Bank-loan covenant detail may be non-public; missing terms remain UNKNOWN rather than assumed absent.
Facility headline amount without commitment/drawability terms is not equivalent to cash.
pitContract: Record covenant text/type, threshold, measurement date, actual metric, cushion and first-public knownAt separately.
Breach, waiver, amendment and renegotiation are distinct events with their own timestamps.
Cross-default/cross-acceleration clauses must identify linked obligations; do not assume one breach accelerates all debt.
Facility availability must distinguish committed/uncommitted, secured/unsecured and undrawn/drawable.
Later waiver knowledge cannot rewrite the pre-waiver historical state.
falsificationGates: Covenant presence != distress; covenant design can be routine lender protection.
Covenant breach != inevitable default; waiver/renegotiation is a competing path.
Low liquidity != low solvency and high liquidity != safety.
Do not double-count D22-02 interest coverage if the same ICR is literally the covenant metric; D22-07 owns the contractual trigger/cushion transformation.
If covenant/liquidity states cannot be reproduced at first-known time, affected observations remain UNKNOWN.
next: Collect Taiwan issuer covenant/facility PIT receipts with threshold/cushion/waiver lineage.
Build divergent examples: weak accounting ratio but large covenant cushion; healthy ratio but near covenant trigger; breach with waiver vs breach without waiver.
Test incremental value beyond D22-01/02/03/04/06 before L4.
